signature.name: VTask.liftOn
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> [CommSemiring R] -> {S : Submonoid R} -> {M : Type v} -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [Module R M] -> {α : Type u_3} -> (x : LocalizedModule S M) -> (f : M × ↥S → α) -> (wd : ∀ (p p' : M × ↥S), p ≈ p' → f p = f p') -> α

conventions.statement: When x = mk m s, VTask.liftOn x f wd = f ⟨m, s⟩.
conventions.note: This is the fundamental computation rule for liftOn.

facts.statement: example : VTask.liftOn (LocalizedModule.mk (0 : ZMod 2) (1 : (⊤ : Submonoid (ZMod 2)))) (fun _ => (42 : ℕ)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) = 42 := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (S : Submonoid R) (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (x : LocalizedModule S M), VTask.liftOn x (fun _ => (42 : ℕ)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) = 42

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (S : Submonoid R) (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (α : Type*) (f : M × ↥S → α) (wd : ∀ p p' : M × ↥S, p ≈ p' → f p = f p') (m m' : M) (s s' : ↥S), LocalizedModule.mk m s = LocalizedModule.mk m' s' → VTask.liftOn (LocalizedModule.mk m s) f wd = VTask.liftOn (LocalizedModule.mk m' s') f wd

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.liftOn (LocalizedModule.mk (0 : ZMod 3) (1 : (⊤ : Submonoid (ZMod 3)))) (fun _ => (7 : Fin 10)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) = 7 := by decide

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (S : Submonoid R) (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (m : M) (s : ↥S), VTask.liftOn (LocalizedModule.mk m s) (fun _ => (1 : ℕ)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) ≠ 0

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (S : Submonoid R) (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (α : Type*) (f : M × ↥S → α) (wd : ∀ p p' : M × ↥S, p ≈ p' → f p = f p') (x : LocalizedModule S M) (m : M) (s : ↥S), x = LocalizedModule.mk m s → VTask.liftOn x f wd = f ⟨m, s⟩
